snippet.title: Tingus Goose - Official PC Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Tingus Goose is a delightfully absurd idle game where you plant seeds in patients, bounce babies for profit, and ascend through surreal worlds toward riches. Nothing can prepare you for this surreal Tingus Goose trailer for this idle game from the twisted mind of animator MasterTingus. Check it out. Tingus Goose will be available on Steam on November 20, 2025.
